failure_policy: Actual CPU backend parity failures are retained, not turned into passes.

outcomes.name: combined_finite_head_metrics_and_guarded_backward
outcomes.decision: Combined reference-ordered metrics and guarded compact native-autograd backward match these CPU fixtures exactly, including selected FP16 logits/dX16. Dense-versus-gathered GPU GEMM equivalence remains open.

outcomes.name: full_geometry_exceptional_guard_dispatch
outcomes.decision: Conservative guards plus recomputation of the original full geometry preserve these exceptional CPU paths. Finite loss is not a sufficient guard; upstream failures require the original full hidden state.

outcomes.name: metric_nonfinite_and_final_position_discriminators
outcomes.decision: Do not select entropy mask rows, replace 0*−Inf with zero, or drop final ignored logits from the main CE graph: these alter observed exceptional semantics.

outcomes.name: synthetic_metric_packet_lifecycle
outcomes.decision: Synthetic FIFO protocol rejects stale/duplicate packets and isolates eval from train. Row means cannot replace global CE; this is not verified Soup/TRL integration.

outcomes.name: nf4_exhaustive_independent_metadata_and_cpu_decode
outcomes.decision: Independent decoders agree and exhaustive manually constructed QuantStates compare to installed CPU decode. Actual-table data and synthetic tables are distinguished; no CUDA or real-model state claim.

outcomes.name: actual_nested_quantstate_and_public_layouts
outcomes.decision: Tiny actual nested CPU quantizer states and public decode layouts are checked. Byte reinterpretation is not numeric casting; single-byte canonical storage also triggers the API transpose quirk.

outcomes.name: forward_backward_dtype_and_inner_block_contracts
outcomes.decision: Forward requested dtype and backward QuantState-dtype-then-grad-dtype are distinct contracts. Generic dequant inner-block metadata is not MatMul4Bit forward eligibility; no optional CPU GEMM package installed.

outcomes.name: actual_cpu_row_alignment_parity_probe
outcomes.decision: Retain any [3,80] parity failure as a CPU-backend oracle limitation. Do not redefine the flat-format oracle to match it, infer CUDA failure, or install/fix unrelated kernels.
